summary: Arbe Robotics filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release about a Nasdaq minimum bid price deficiency notice. The notice, dated April 13, 2026, is based on the closing bid price being below $1.00 per share for 30 consecutive business days. The company has a 180-day cure period until October 12, 2026, and may be eligible for an additional 180 days if it meets other listing standards. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisors are mentioned. This is a routine deficiency notification with no special-situation event such as a going-private, restructuring, or delisting.
